<!-- Pull-request description written by the implementor: the report of
     protocols/templates/report.md, in the carrier for code-changing work. A copy lives in each
     pilot repository as .github/pull_request_template.md. Title: "<issue-id>: <issue title>".
     An outcome of completed without evidence is treated as failed. -->

Issue: <!-- e.g. COS-42 -->
Round: 1

## Summary
<!-- Three sentences at most, in plain language. -->

## Outcome
<!-- completed | failed | blocked -->

## Failure type
<!-- Only when failed or blocked: transient | environment | permission | requirement | logic -->

## Changes
<!-- Each change with its evidence: file and line, commit. -->

## Acceptance criteria
<!-- Each criterion from the issue: how it is met, and the evidence. -->

## Tests
<!-- The exact command and its output, verbatim. -->

## Documentation
<!-- What was updated, or why nothing needed updating. -->

## Risk triggers
<!-- Paths or keywords from the fixed list (hub protocols/approval-policy.md) and the project's
     AGENTS.md that this change touches, or "none found". -->

## Not done

## Follow-ups
<!-- Each marked in scope or out of scope. Out-of-scope findings are not fixed in this PR. -->

## Assumptions

## Learning candidates
